title: Error Handling

sections.content: Programs fail — bad input, missing files, network drops. Error handling catches failures gracefully instead of crashing.
The pattern: try risky code, catch the specific failure, and decide what to do (retry, default value, friendly message). Finally blocks run cleanup either way.
Key points: catch specific error types, never swallow errors silently, and validate input early to prevent most failures.
